cli.description: High-Accuracy Classical OpenCV Image Matcher – two-stage (fast pre-filter + precise verification), multi-feature-detector (SIFT/AKAZE/ORB/BRISK) image search.
cli.epilog:
Examples:
  python run.py --reference "D:\reference-images" --source "E:\source" --output runs\2026-08-11
  python run.py -r ref_folder -s src_folder -o out --profile high_recall -w 6 --top-k 10
  python run.py -r ref -s src -o out --dry-run
  python run.py --list-profiles

Precedence: explicit CLI flag > --profile file > config.yaml default.
Fine-tuning settings (thresholds, detector parameters, CLAHE,
homography check, cache size, top-k, etc.) can be found in config.yaml
and the profiles/*.yaml files, with comments.
cli.help.lang: The program's language (available: {available}). Current default: {default} (from config.yaml's default_language key). Passing --lang <code> alone (with no other flag) sets this permanently.
cli.help.profile: Load a named profile from the profiles/ folder (e.g. --profile diagnostic, --profile high_recall, --profile balanced). If not specified, only config.yaml defaults apply.
cli.help.source: Folder of original, full-size images to search the references in.
cli.help.output: Output folder: this is where the found/ subfolder, results.csv, results_candidates.csv and the log file will be placed.
cli.help.limit: Only process the first N references (alphabetical order, for quick testing).
cli.help.workers: Number of parallel threads. Defaults to the number of CPU cores.
cli.help.top_k: How many candidates advance from stage 1 to stage 2. (default: the stage1_top_k value from config.yaml/profile)
cli.help.cache: Location of the cache folder (defaults to <output>/cache).
cli.help.no_cache: Completely disables caching (neither image nor descriptor cache; everything is recomputed on every run).
cli.help.rebuild_cache: Ignores and overwrites existing cache content (forced regeneration), then continues writing cache afterwards.
cli.help.dry_run: Validates the paths and resolved settings, counts the images to be processed, but does not run an actual search.
cli.help.version: Prints the program version and exits.
cli.help.list_profiles: Lists the profiles available in the profiles/ folder and exits.

profiles.balanced.description: Strict thresholds, 0 false matches on a real test set (the factory defaults from config.yaml).
profiles.high_recall.description: Looser thresholds for better recall, at the cost of higher false-match risk.
profiles.diagnostic.description: Very loose thresholds + never early-accepts, specifically for threshold tuning.

gui.profile_field.max_process_size.help: Maximum longer side for the precise (stage 2) processing, in pixels – higher means more detail but more memory/time.
gui.profile_field.min_process_size.help: Minimum longer side after scaling – smaller images get upscaled to this.
gui.profile_field.use_clahe.help: Enable adaptive histogram equalization (CLAHE) before feature detection.
gui.profile_field.clahe_clip_limit.help: How strong the CLAHE contrast boost is – too high can also amplify noise.
gui.profile_field.clahe_tile_size.help: The image is split into this many × this many tiles, each contrast-equalized separately.
gui.profile_field.use_homography_check.h: "Magnet image" protection: rejects geometrically implausible (e.g. mirrored, extremely sheared) RANSAC matches.
gui.profile_field.max_homography_shear_r: Maximum allowed ratio between the two singular values of the estimated homography (shear/anisotropy).
gui.profile_field.min_homography_scale.h: Smallest allowed scale factor for the estimated homography.
gui.profile_field.max_homography_scale.h: Largest allowed scale factor for the estimated homography.
Only affects logging/categorization (ACCEPT_STRONG_GEOMETRY vs. ACCEPT_INLIER), not the accept decision itself.
gui.profile_field.detector_priority.help: The order in which feature detectors are tried in stage 2.
gui.profile_field.sift_nfeatures.help: Maximum number of best keypoints kept by the SIFT detector.
gui.profile_field.sift_contrast.help: SIFT's contrast threshold – higher means fewer but more stable keypoints.
gui.profile_field.sift_edge.help: SIFT's edge threshold – lower filters edge-like, unstable keypoints more aggressively.
gui.profile_field.sift_sigma.help: The sigma of SIFT's initial Gaussian blur.
gui.profile_field.akaze_threshold.help: AKAZE detector's response threshold – lower gives more, but noisier keypoints.
gui.profile_field.akaze_n_octaves.help: Number of scale octaves examined by AKAZE.
gui.profile_field.akaze_n_layers.help: Number of sublevels per octave for AKAZE.
gui.profile_field.orb_nfeatures.help: Maximum number of best keypoints kept by the ORB detector.
gui.profile_field.orb_scale_factor.help: The size ratio between consecutive levels of ORB's scale pyramid.
gui.profile_field.orb_n_levels.help: Number of levels in ORB's scale pyramid.
gui.profile_field.brisk_thresh.help: BRISK detector's response threshold – lower gives more keypoints.
gui.profile_field.brisk_octaves.help: Number of scale octaves examined by BRISK.
gui.profile_field.ratio_test_sift.help: Lowe ratio test threshold for SIFT (and other float descriptors) – lower is a stricter filter.
gui.profile_field.ratio_test_bin.help: Lowe ratio test threshold for binary descriptors (AKAZE/ORB/BRISK).
gui.profile_field.min_good_matches.help: Minimum "good" matches required before starting the geometric (RANSAC) check.
gui.profile_field.min_inliers.help: Minimum RANSAC inliers for final acceptance (base branch).
gui.profile_field.ratio_compensation_bar: Branch B's minimum inlier ratio – a high inlier ratio can compensate for a lower absolute inlier count.
gui.profile_field.relaxed_min_inliers.he: Branch B's minimum absolute inlier count.
gui.profile_field.inlier_compensation_ba: Branch C's minimum absolute inlier count – a high inlier count can compensate for a lower ratio.
gui.profile_field.ransac_reproj.help: RANSAC's allowed reprojection error, in pixels.
gui.profile_field.score_accept.help: Above this score, we no longer try a lower-priority detector.
gui.profile_field.score_uncertain.help: The actual acceptance score threshold – only above this counts as a confirmed match.
gui.profile_field.early_accept_score.hel: If the first (highest-priority) detector already reaches this, the remaining detectors aren't tried at all.
gui.profile_field.cache_long_side.help: Longer side (in pixels) of the stage-1 (fast, downscaled) cache images.
gui.profile_field.cache_jpeg_quality.hel: JPEG quality of the cache images.
gui.profile_field.stage1_ratio.help: Lowe ratio test threshold in stage 1 (the fast pre-filter).
gui.profile_field.stage1_min_good_matche: Just a technical minimum in stage 1 (RANSAC needs a few points) – NOT an exclusion threshold.
gui.profile_field.stage1_top_k.help: How many candidates advance from stage 1 into the precise stage 2.
gui.profile_field.use_downscale_retry.he: Enable the fallback round for small native-resolution references.
gui.profile_field.small_reference_native: Native longer side (in pixels) below which a reference counts as "small" for the fallback round.
gui.profile_field.downscale_retry_factor: How much the candidate source is downscaled in the fallback round – documented useful range is roughly 0.3–3.0.
